segments.tr: هذه الظاهرة لها اسم يسبق علم البراكين الحديث: *البراديسيزم* (bradyseism)، من الكلمة اليونانية التي تعني "الحركة البطيئة".

segments.src: It describes the gradual rise and fall of the ground surface inside a volcanic caldera, driven not by lava but by pressure — hot fluids, gases, and possibly magma at depth pushing the rock above them upward like a slow hydraulic jack, then letting it settle again.
segments.tr: وهي تصف الارتفاع والانخفاض التدريجي لسطح الأرض داخل كالديرا بركانية، مدفوعاً ليس بالحمم البركانية ولكن بالضغط - السوائل الساخنة والغازات وربما الماغما في الأعماق التي تدفع الصخور التي فوقها للأعلى مثل رافعة هيدروليكية بطيئة، ثم تتركها تستقر مرة أخرى.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is the textbook case.
segments.tr: كامبي فليغري هي الحالة النموذجية.

segments.src: The Romans built a market at Pozzuoli, the Macellum, whose surviving columns carry a band of holes bored by marine mollusks several meters above the modern floor.
segments.tr: بنى الرومان سوقاً في بوتسولي، وهو Macellum، حيث تحمل أعمدته المتبقية شريطاً من الثقوب التي حفرتها الرخويات البحرية على ارتفاع عدة أمتار فوق الأرضية الحديثة.

segments.src: Those holes are a tide gauge running two thousand years long.
segments.tr: تلك الثقوب هي مقياس للمد والجزر يمتد لألفي عام.

segments.src: The ground sank below sea level, sat there for centuries, and rose again.
segments.tr: غاصت الأرض تحت مستوى سطح البحر، وبقيت هناك لقرون، ثم ارتفعت مرة أخرى.

segments.src: Naples has been living on a piston this whole time.
segments.tr: كانت نابولي تعيش فوق مكبس طوال هذا الوقت.

segments.src: The caldera itself is about 12 to 15 kilometers across, and most of it is not a mountain.
segments.tr: تبلغ مساحة الكالديرا نفسها حوالي 12 إلى 15 كيلومتراً، ومعظمها ليس جبلاً.

segments.src: It is a shallow bowl of neighborhoods, ports, thermal baths, and highways, partly submerged under the Gulf of Pozzuoli, partly overlapping the western districts of Naples proper.
segments.tr: إنها عبارة عن وعاء ضحل من الأحياء السكنية والموانئ والحمامات الحرارية والطرق السريعة، مغمور جزئياً تحت خليج بوتسولي، ومتداخل جزئياً مع المناطق الغربية من مدينة نابولي نفسها.

segments.src: Roughly half a million people live inside it.
segments.tr: يعيش بداخلها حوالي نصف مليون شخص.

segments.src: That density — European, coastal, historic, and built long before anyone modeled seismic loads — is the variable that turns a geophysics problem into a civil-protection problem.
segments.tr: هذه الكثافة - الأوروبية، والساحلية، والتاريخية، والتي بُنيت قبل وقت طويل من قيام أي شخص بنمذجة الأحمال الزلزالية - هي المتغير الذي يحول مشكلة جيوفيزيائية إلى مشكلة حماية مدنية.

segments.src: ## Why a 4.7 hurts more here
segments.tr: ## لماذا يكون الزلزال بقوة 4.7 أكثر إيلاماً هنا

segments.src: A magnitude 4.7 is not a large earthquake by global standards.
segments.tr: الزلزال بقوة 4.7 درجة ليس زلزالاً كبيراً بالمعايير العالمية.

segments.src: In many parts of the world it would rattle dishes and make the local news for one cycle.
segments.tr: في أجزاء كثيرة من العالم، قد يؤدي ذلك إلى اهتزاز الأطباق وظهوره في الأخبار المحلية لدورة واحدة.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is different for two reasons.
segments.tr: كامبي فليغري مختلفة لسببين.

segments.src: **The quakes are extremely shallow.** Most caldera seismicity here originates within a few kilometers of the surface, some of it much shallower than that.
segments.tr: **الهزات الأرضية ضحلة للغاية.** معظم النشاط الزلزالي في الكالديرا هنا ينشأ ضمن بضعة كيلومترات من السطح، وبعضها أضحل من ذلك بكثير.

segments.src: Energy that would dissipate through the crust on its way up from a 30-kilometer hypocenter instead arrives almost immediately, concentrated under a small area.
segments.tr: الطاقة التي قد تتبدد عبر القشرة الأرضية في طريقها للأعلى من مركز زلزالي على عمق 30 كيلومتراً، تصل بدلاً من ذلك بشكل فوري تقريباً، مركزة تحت منطقة صغيرة.

segments.src: The shaking is sharp, loud, and disproportionate to the magnitude number.
segments.tr: الاهتزاز يكون حاداً، وصاخباً، وغير متناسب مع رقم القوة.

segments.src: **The buildings have been strained for years, not seconds.** This is the point most easily lost.
segments.tr: **المباني كانت تحت الضغط لسنوات، وليس لثوانٍ.** هذه هي النقطة التي يسهل فقدانها أكثر من غيرها.

segments.src: Uplift does not merely precede earthquakes; it deforms structures directly.
segments.tr: الارتفاع لا يسبق الزلازل فحسب؛ بل يشوه الهياكل مباشرة.

segments.src: A masonry building whose foundation has tilted and stretched a few centimeters over a decade is not the same building it was — it has accumulated cracks, lost stiffness, and shed some of its margin.
segments.tr: المبنى المبني من الحجر والذي مالت أساساته وتمددت بضعة سنتيمترات على مدى عقد من الزمان ليس هو نفس المبنى الذي كان عليه - فقد تراكمت فيه الشقوق، وفقد صلابته، وتناقص هامش أمانه.

segments.src: When the sharp shock finally arrives, it lands on a structure already partway through its budget.
segments.tr: عندما تصل الصدمة الحادة أخيراً، فإنها تضرب هيكلاً استنفد بالفعل جزءاً من قدرته على التحمل.

segments.src: That is why local damage reports tend to describe cornices, stairwells, and older masonry rather than dramatic collapses, and it is why Italy's building-survey program in the area has focused on cumulative vulnerability rather than any single event.
segments.tr: هذا هو السبب في أن تقارير الأضرار المحلية تميل إلى وصف الأفاريز، والسلالم، والبناء الحجري القديم بدلاً من الانهيارات الدراماتيكية، وهو السبب في أن برنامج مسح المباني في المنطقة ركز على الضعف التراكمي بدلاً من أي حدث واحد.

segments.src: ## Rising ground is not a countdown
segments.tr: ## الأرض المرتفعة ليست عدداً تنازلياً

segments.src: Here is the part that deserves care, because it is where public understanding usually goes wrong.
segments.tr: هذا هو الجزء الذي يستحق العناية، لأنه حيث يخطئ الفهم العام عادةً.

segments.src: Uplift is not a schedule.
segments.tr: الارتفاع ليس جدولاً زمنياً.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei has been at the "yellow" attention level in Italy's four-tier volcanic alert system since 2012 — a designation that means monitoring has been intensified and parameters are being tracked closely, not that an eruption has been forecast.
segments.tr: كانت كامبي فليغري في مستوى الانتباه "الأصفر" في نظام التنبيه البركاني الإيطالي المكون من أربعة مستويات منذ عام 2012 - وهو تصنيف يعني أن المراقبة قد تكثفت وأن المعايير يتم تتبعها عن كثب، وليس أن ثوراناً قد تم التنبؤ به.

segments.src: The system has three levels above yellow, and moving between them requires specific, agreed-upon changes in the data.
segments.tr: يحتوي النظام على ثلاثة مستويات فوق الأصفر، والانتقال بينها يتطلب تغييرات محددة ومتفق عليها في البيانات.

segments.src: Researchers broadly work with two overlapping explanations for the current unrest, and the honest answer is that they are difficult to separate from the surface:
segments.tr: يعمل الباحثون بشكل عام مع تفسيرين متداخلين للاضطراب الحالي، والإجابة الصادقة هي أنه من الصعب فصلهما من السطح:

segments.src: - **A hydrothermal interpretation.** Superheated water and gas — much of it originating from magma sitting several kilometers down — migrate into shallow rock, pressurize it, and lift it. This can produce years of uplift, gas emission, and shallow seismicity without magma itself rising to shallow depth.
segments.tr: - **تفسير هيدروحراري.** مياه وغازات شديدة السخونة - ينشأ الكثير منها من الماغما الموجودة على عمق عدة كيلومترات - تهاجر إلى الصخور الضحلة، وتضغطها، وترفعها. يمكن أن يؤدي هذا إلى سنوات من الارتفاع، وانبعاث الغازات، والنشاط الزلزالي الضحل دون أن ترتفع الماغما نفسها إلى عمق ضحل.

segments.src: - **A magmatic interpretation.** A body of magma at depth is intruding or degassing more actively, driving the same signals from below.
segments.tr: - **تفسير ماغماتي.** جسم من الماغما في الأعماق يتسلل أو يطلق الغازات بشكل أكثر نشاطاً، مما يؤدي إلى نفس الإشارات من الأسفل.

segments.src: Both produce uplift.
segments.tr: كلاهما يؤدي إلى الارتفاع.

segments.src: Both produce earthquakes.
segments.tr: كلاهما يؤدي إلى الزلازل.

segments.src: The discriminating evidence tends to come from gas chemistry, deformation patterns, and how the crust responds to repeated stress — and recent work has emphasized a third factor that complicates the picture: after decades of being stretched and shaken, the shallow crust here may simply be weaker than it was, meaning it fractures at lower stress than it used to.
segments.tr: تميل الأدلة المميزة إلى المجيء من كيمياء الغازات، وأنماط التشوه، وكيفية استجابة القشرة للإجهاد المتكرر - وقد أكدت الأعمال الحديثة على عامل ثالث يعقد الصورة: بعد عقود من التمدد والاهتزاز، قد تكون القشرة الضحلة هنا ببساطة أضعف مما كانت عليه، مما يعني أنها تتكسر عند إجهاد أقل مما كانت عليه في السابق.

segments.src: Under that reading, more frequent earthquakes are partly a sign of a fatigued lid, not necessarily a stronger push from beneath.
segments.tr: وفقاً لهذه القراءة، فإن الزلازل الأكثر تكراراً هي جزئياً علامة على غطاء مجهد، وليس بالضرورة دفعاً أقوى من الأسفل.

segments.src: That is a genuinely important nuance, and it cuts both ways.
segments.tr: هذا فارق دقيق ومهم حقاً، وهو يعمل في الاتجاهين.

segments.src: It offers a less alarming explanation for rising quake counts.
segments.tr: فهو يقدم تفسيراً أقل إثارة للقلق لزيادة عدد الزلازل.

segments.src: It also means the system's behavior is changing in ways that make historical analogies less reliable.
segments.tr: كما يعني أيضاً أن سلوك النظام يتغير بطرق تجعل القياسات التاريخية أقل موثوقية.

segments.src: ## The 1982–84 precedent
The last major bradyseismic crisis ran from 1982 to 1984 and lifted the ground at Pozzuoli by roughly 1.8 meters.
segments.tr: استمرت آخر أزمة براديسيزم كبرى من عام 1982 إلى عام 1984 ورفعت الأرض في بوتسولي بمقدار 1.8 متر تقريباً.

segments.src: Tens of thousands of residents were relocated; the old town core of Rione Terra was evacuated and stayed largely empty for years afterward.
segments.tr: تم نقل عشرات الآلاف من السكان؛ وتم إخلاء مركز المدينة القديمة في Rione Terra وبقي فارغاً إلى حد كبير لسنوات بعد ذلك.

segments.src: Then the ground stopped, settled somewhat, and the crisis ended without an eruption.
segments.tr: ثم توقفت الأرض، واستقرت نوعاً ما، وانتهت الأزمة دون ثوران.

segments.src: That is the most useful precedent available, and it points in a reassuring direction — sustained, meters-scale uplift ended quietly.
segments.tr: هذه هي السابقة الأكثر فائدة المتاحة، وهي تشير إلى اتجاه مطمئن - ارتفاع مستمر بمقياس الأمتار انتهى بهدوء.

segments.src: But the current episode has now run far longer than that one, at a slower rate, and it is arriving in a place with two more generations of construction on top of it.
segments.tr: لكن الحلقة الحالية استمرت الآن لفترة أطول بكثير من تلك، وبمعدل أبطأ، وهي تحدث في مكان تضاف إليه جيلان آخران من البناء.

segments.src: ## What is being watched, and what would change the assessment
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يتم مراقبته، وما الذي قد يغير التقييم

segments.src: If you want to follow this the way monitoring agencies do, the meaningful indicators are not the magnitude headlines.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تريد متابعة هذا بالطريقة التي تفعلها وكالات المراقبة، فإن المؤشرات ذات المغزى ليست عناوين القوة الزلزالية.

segments.src: They are:
segments.tr: بل هي:

segments.src: - **Uplift rate**, measured in millimeters per month by GPS stations and satellite radar. Acceleration matters far more than the accumulated total.
segments.tr: - **معدل الارتفاع**، ويقاس بالملليمترات في الشهر بواسطة محطات GPS والرادار الساتلي. التسارع يهم أكثر بكثير من الإجمالي المتراكم.

segments.src: - **Earthquake depth.** Persistent shallow activity fits the hydrothermal picture. A sustained migration of seismicity toward the surface, or new activity at intermediate depths, would be a different signal.
segments.tr: - **عمق الزلزال.** النشاط الضحل المستمر يتناسب مع الصورة الهيدروحرارية. الهجرة المستمرة للنشاط الزلزالي نحو السطح، أو نشاط جديد في أعماق متوسطة، سيكون إشارة مختلفة.

segments.src: - **Gas chemistry** at the Solfatara and Pisciarelli fumarole fields — particularly the ratios of carbon dioxide to water vapor and helium isotopes, which help distinguish a magmatic contribution from a purely hydrothermal one.
segments.tr: - **كيمياء الغازات** في حقول الفومارول في Solfatara و Pisciarelli - وخاصة نسب ثاني أكسيد الكربون إلى بخار الماء ونظائر الهيليوم، والتي تساعد في تمييز المساهمة الماغماتية عن المساهمة الهيدروحرارية البحتة.

segments.src: - **Ground temperature and emission flux**, which track how much heat the system is moving.
segments.tr: - **درجة حرارة الأرض وتدفق الانبعاثات**، والتي تتبع مقدار الحرارة التي ينقلها النظام.

segments.src: None of those has a single threshold that flips a switch.
segments.tr: لا يوجد لأي من هذه الأشياء عتبة واحدة تقلب المفتاح.

segments.src: Alert-level changes are made on a package of evidence by a national commission, not on any one reading.
segments.tr: تغييرات مستوى التنبيه تتم بناءً على مجموعة من الأدلة من قبل لجنة وطنية، وليس بناءً على قراءة واحدة.

segments.src: ## The practical layer
segments.tr: ## الطبقة العملية

segments.src: For residents and visitors, the operative guidance is unglamorous and comes from Italy's Civil Protection Department and municipal authorities, not from any article:
segments.tr: بالنسبة للسكان والزوار، فإن الإرشادات التشغيلية غير مبهرة وتأتي من إدارة الحماية المدنية الإيطالية والسلطات البلدية، وليس من أي مقال:

segments.src: - Know whether your address falls in the designated hazard zones, and know the assigned assembly points and evacuation route — the local comune publishes them.
segments.tr: - اعرف ما إذا كان عنوانك يقع في مناطق الخطر المحددة، واعرف نقاط التجمع المحددة وطريق الإخلاء - تنشرها البلدية المحلية (comune).

segments.src: - Keep the standard earthquake habits: secure heavy furniture, know which interior wall or doorway you would move to, keep documents and medications somewhere you can grab them.
segments.tr: - حافظ على عادات الزلازل القياسية: ثبت الأثاث الثقيل، واعرف أي جدار داخلي أو مدخل ستنتقل إليه، واحتفظ بالمستندات والأدوية في مكان يمكنك التقاطه.

segments.src: - Treat official channels as the source of truth during an event. Aftershock sequences in this caldera routinely produce a wave of speculation that outruns the data by hours.
segments.tr: - تعامل مع القنوات الرسمية كمصدر للحقيقة أثناء الحدث. تسلسلات الهزات الارتدادية في هذه الكالديرا تنتج روتينياً موجة من التكهنات التي تسبق البيانات بساعات.

segments.src: - If a building has been posted as unusable after inspection, that assessment reflects strain that is not always visible from the street.
segments.tr: - إذا تم وضع علامة على مبنى بأنه غير صالح للاستخدام بعد التفتيش، فإن هذا التقييم يعكس إجهاداً لا يكون مرئياً دائماً من الشارع.

segments.src: ## The wider point
segments.tr: ## النقطة الأوسع

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is a stress test for something more general than volcanology.
segments.tr: كامبي فليغري هي اختبار جهد لشيء أكثر عمومية من علم البراكين.

segments.src: It is what happens when a slow-moving natural hazard sits under a place people cannot simply leave — where the housing is old, the economy is local, the deadline is unknown, and the honest scientific answer is "we are monitoring it, and it may go on like this for years."
segments.tr: إنه ما يحدث عندما يقع خطر طبيعي بطيء الحركة تحت مكان لا يمكن للناس ببساطة مغادرته - حيث تكون المساكن قديمة، والاقتصاد محلي، والموعد النهائي غير معروف، والإجابة العلمية الصادقة هي "نحن نراقب الأمر، وقد يستمر على هذا النحو لسنوات".

segments.src: The port reopens.
segments.tr: يعاد فتح الميناء.

segments.src: The households return or they don't.
segments.tr: تعود الأسر أو لا تعود.

segments.src: The instruments keep logging millimeters.
segments.tr: تستمر الأجهزة في تسجيل المليمترات.

segments.src: Four and a half feet accumulated in twenty-one years is not a headline on any single day, which is precisely why it took a magnitude 4.7 to make anyone outside Naples look at it.
segments.tr: أربع أقدام ونصف تراكمت في واحد وعشرين عاماً ليست عنواناً رئيسياً في أي يوم واحد، وهذا بالضبط هو السبب في أن الأمر تطلب زلزالاً بقوة 4.7 درجة لجعل أي شخص خارج نابولي ينظر إليه.

segments.src: *This article summarizes publicly reported information and the current published scientific understanding of the Campi Flegrei caldera.
segments.tr: *هذا المقال يلخص المعلومات المبلغ عنها علناً والفهم العلمي المنشور حالياً لكالديرا كامبي فليغري.

segments.src: Figures on damage, injuries, and displacement reflect initial official reports and are commonly revised.
segments.tr: الأرقام المتعلقة بالأضرار والإصابات والنزوح تعكس التقارير الرسمية الأولية وعادة ما يتم مراجعتها.

segments.src: It is general information, not emergency guidance — for situation-specific instructions, follow Italy's Civil Protection Department and local municipal authorities.*
segments.tr: إنها معلومات عامة، وليست إرشادات طوارئ - للحصول على تعليمات خاصة بالموقف، اتبع إدارة الحماية المدنية الإيطالية والسلطات البلدية المحلية.*

fr.title: Le sol sous Naples s'est élevé de quatre pieds et demi : inside le signal d'alarme de 40 ans des Campi Flegrei

segments.src: On the last day of July, the ground west of Naples moved hard enough to close a working port.
segments.tr: Le dernier jour de juillet, le sol à l'ouest de Naples a bougé suffisamment pour fermer un port en activité.

segments.src: The magnitude 4.7 earthquake that struck the Campi Flegrei caldera on July 31 was, by the reckoning of Italy's national geophysics institute, the strongest tremor the area has produced in roughly four decades.
segments.tr: Le séisme de magnitude 4,7 qui a frappé la caldeira des Campi Flegrei le 31 juillet était, selon l'institut national de géophysique d'Italie, la secousse la plus forte que la région ait connue depuis environ quatre décennies.

segments.src: Twenty-six people were reported injured.
segments.tr: Vingt-six personnes ont été signalées blessées.

segments.src: Around 130 households were emptied while engineers checked walls and stairwells.
segments.tr: Environ 130 foyers ont été évacués pendant que les ingénieurs vérifiaient les murs et les cages d'escalier.

segments.src: The port of Pozzuoli — the ferry link to Ischia and Procida, and a piece of ordinary economic infrastructure for tens of thousands of people — was closed for inspection.
segments.tr: Le port de Pozzuoli — le lien par ferry vers Ischia et Procida, et une infrastructure économique ordinaire pour des dizaines de milliers de personnes — a été fermé pour inspection.

segments.src: Those are the numbers that traveled.
segments.tr: Ce sont les chiffres qui ont circulé.

segments.src: But they are not the story.
segments.tr: Mais ce n'est pas l'histoire.

segments.src: The story is slower, quieter, and considerably stranger: the floor of the caldera has been rising, more or less continuously, for two decades.
segments.tr: L'histoire est plus lente, plus silencieuse et considérablement plus étrange : le fond de la caldeira s'élève, plus ou moins continuellement, depuis deux décennies.

segments.src: Since 2005, the ground at the center of the uplift has swelled by more than 140 centimeters — about four and a half feet.
segments.tr: Depuis 2005, le sol au centre du soulèvement s'est gonflé de plus de 140 centimètres — environ quatre pieds et demi.

segments.src: That is not a metaphor.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas une métaphore.

segments.src: The coastline near Pozzuoli is physically higher than it was when the first iPhone shipped.
segments.tr: Le littoral près de Pozzuoli est physiquement plus haut qu'il ne l'était lors de l'expédition du premier iPhone.

segments.src: ## What bradyseism actually is
segments.tr: ## Qu'est-ce que le bradyseisme en réalité

segments.src: The phenomenon has a name that predates modern volcanology: *bradyseism*, from the Greek for "slow movement."
segments.tr: Le phénomène a un nom qui précède la volcanologie moderne : le *bradyseisme*, du grec signifiant "mouvement lent".

segments.src: It describes the gradual rise and fall of the ground surface inside a volcanic caldera, driven not by lava but by pressure — hot fluids, gases, and possibly magma at depth pushing the rock above them upward like a slow hydraulic jack, then letting it settle again.
segments.tr: Il décrit l'élévation et l'abaissement graduels de la surface du sol à l'intérieur d'une caldeira volcanique, entraînés non pas par la lave, mais par la pression — des fluides chauds, des gaz et éventuellement du magma en profondeur poussant la roche au-dessus d'eux vers le haut comme un cric hydraulique lent, puis la laissant redescendre.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is the textbook case.
segments.tr: Les Campi Flegrei sont le cas d'école.

segments.src: The Romans built a market at Pozzuoli, the Macellum, whose surviving columns carry a band of holes bored by marine mollusks several meters above the modern floor.
segments.tr: Les Romains ont construit un marché à Pozzuoli, le Macellum, dont les colonnes survivantes portent une bande de trous percés par des mollusques marins plusieurs mètres au-dessus du sol moderne.

segments.src: Those holes are a tide gauge running two thousand years long.
segments.tr: Ces trous sont un marégraphe s'étendant sur deux mille ans.

segments.src: The ground sank below sea level, sat there for centuries, and rose again.
segments.tr: Le sol a coulé sous le niveau de la mer, y est resté pendant des siècles, puis s'est élevé à nouveau.

segments.src: Naples has been living on a piston this whole time.
segments.tr: Naples vit sur un piston depuis tout ce temps.

segments.src: The caldera itself is about 12 to 15 kilometers across, and most of it is not a mountain.
segments.tr: La caldeira elle-même mesure environ 12 à 15 kilomètres de large, et la majeure partie n'est pas une montagne.

segments.src: It is a shallow bowl of neighborhoods, ports, thermal baths, and highways, partly submerged under the Gulf of Pozzuoli, partly overlapping the western districts of Naples proper.
segments.tr: C'est un bol peu profond composé de quartiers, de ports, de bains thermaux et d'autoroutes, partiellement submergé sous le golfe de Pozzuoli, et chevauchant en partie les districts occidentaux de Naples même.

segments.src: Roughly half a million people live inside it.
segments.tr: Environ un demi-million de personnes y vivent.

segments.src: That density — European, coastal, historic, and built long before anyone modeled seismic loads — is the variable that turns a geophysics problem into a civil-protection problem.
segments.tr: Cette densité — européenne, côtière, historique et construite bien avant que quiconque ne modélise les charges sismiques — est la variable qui transforme un problème de géophysique en un problème de protection civile.

segments.src: ## Why a 4.7 hurts more here
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi un 4,7 fait plus de dégâts ici

segments.src: A magnitude 4.7 is not a large earthquake by global standards.
segments.tr: Une magnitude de 4,7 n'est pas un séisme important selon les normes mondiales.

segments.src: In many parts of the world it would rattle dishes and make the local news for one cycle.
segments.tr: Dans beaucoup de régions du monde, cela ferait trembler la vaisselle et passerait aux informations locales pour un cycle.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is different for two reasons.
segments.tr: Les Campi Flegrei sont différents pour deux raisons.

segments.src: **The quakes are extremely shallow.** Most caldera seismicity here originates within a few kilometers of the surface, some of it much shallower than that.
segments.tr: **Les séismes sont extrêmement superficiels.** La plupart de la sismicité de la caldeira ici provient de quelques kilomètres seulement de la surface, certains étant bien plus superficiels encore.

segments.src: Energy that would dissipate through the crust on its way up from a 30-kilometer hypocenter instead arrives almost immediately, concentrated under a small area.
segments.tr: L'énergie qui se dissiperait à travers la croûte lors de sa remontée depuis un hypocentre à 30 kilomètres arrive instead presque immédiatement, concentrée sous une petite zone.

segments.src: The shaking is sharp, loud, and disproportionate to the magnitude number.
segments.tr: La secousse est vive, bruyante et disproportionnée par rapport au chiffre de la magnitude.

segments.src: **The buildings have been strained for years, not seconds.** This is the point most easily lost.
segments.tr: **Les bâtiments ont été soumis à des tensions pendant des années, pas des secondes.** C'est le point le plus facilement oublié.

segments.src: Uplift does not merely precede earthquakes; it deforms structures directly.
segments.tr: Le soulèvement ne précède pas seulement les séismes ; il déforme directement les structures.

segments.src: A masonry building whose foundation has tilted and stretched a few centimeters over a decade is not the same building it was — it has accumulated cracks, lost stiffness, and shed some of its margin.
segments.tr: Un bâtiment en maçonnerie dont les fondations ont basculé et se sont étirées de quelques centimètres sur une décennie n'est plus le même bâtiment qu'avant — il a accumulé des fissures, a perdu de sa rigidité et a réduit sa marge de sécurité.

segments.src: When the sharp shock finally arrives, it lands on a structure already partway through its budget.
segments.tr: Lorsque le choc brutal arrive enfin, il frappe une structure qui a déjà consommé une partie de sa résistance.

segments.src: That is why local damage reports tend to describe cornices, stairwells, and older masonry rather than dramatic collapses, and it is why Italy's building-survey program in the area has focused on cumulative vulnerability rather than any single event.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les rapports de dommages locaux ont tendance à décrire des corniches, des cages d'escalier et de la maçonnerie ancienne plutôt que des effondrements spectaculaires, et c'est pourquoi le programme d'inspection des bâtiments en Italie dans la zone s'est concentré sur la vulnérabilité cumulative plutôt que sur un événement unique.

segments.src: ## Rising ground is not a countdown
segments.tr: ## Le soulèvement du sol n'est pas un compte à rebours

segments.src: Here is the part that deserves care, because it is where public understanding usually goes wrong.
segments.tr: Voici la partie qui mérite attention, car c'est là que la compréhension du public fait généralement erreur.

segments.src: Uplift is not a schedule.
segments.tr: Le soulèvement n'est pas un calendrier.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei has been at the "yellow" attention level in Italy's four-tier volcanic alert system since 2012 — a designation that means monitoring has been intensified and parameters are being tracked closely, not that an eruption has been forecast.
segments.tr: Les Campi Flegrei sont au niveau d'attention "jaune" du système d'alerte volcanique à quatre niveaux de l'Italie depuis 2012 — une désignation qui signifie que la surveillance a été intensifiée et que les paramètres sont suivis de près, et non qu'une éruption a été prévue.

segments.src: The system has three levels above yellow, and moving between them requires specific, agreed-upon changes in the data.
segments.tr: Le système comporte trois niveaux au-dessus du jaune, et passer de l'un à l'autre nécessite des changements spécifiques et convenus dans les données.

segments.src: Researchers broadly work with two overlapping explanations for the current unrest, and the honest answer is that they are difficult to separate from the surface:
segments.tr: Les chercheurs travaillent globalement avec deux explications qui se chevauchent pour l'agitation actuelle, et la réponse honnête est qu'elles sont difficiles à séparer depuis la surface :

segments.src: - **A hydrothermal interpretation.** Superheated water and gas — much of it originating from magma sitting several kilometers down — migrate into shallow rock, pressurize it, and lift it. This can produce years of uplift, gas emission, and shallow seismicity without magma itself rising to shallow depth.
segments.tr: - **Une interprétation hydrothermale.** De l'eau et du gaz surchauffés — dont une grande partie provient du magma situé à plusieurs kilomètres de profondeur — migrent dans la roche superficielle, la pressurisent et la soulèvent. Cela peut produire des années de soulèvement, d'émissions de gaz et de sismicité superficielle sans que le magma lui-même ne remonte à faible profondeur.

segments.src: - **A magmatic interpretation.** A body of magma at depth is intruding or degassing more actively, driving the same signals from below.
segments.tr: - **Une interprétation magmatique.** Un corps de magma en profondeur s'introduit ou dégaze plus activement, entraînant les mêmes signaux depuis le bas.

segments.src: Both produce uplift.
segments.tr: Les deux produisent un soulèvement.

segments.src: Both produce earthquakes.
segments.tr: Les deux produisent des séismes.

segments.src: The discriminating evidence tends to come from gas chemistry, deformation patterns, and how the crust responds to repeated stress — and recent work has emphasized a third factor that complicates the picture: after decades of being stretched and shaken, the shallow crust here may simply be weaker than it was, meaning it fractures at lower stress than it used to.
segments.tr: Les preuves discriminantes ont tendance à provenir de la chimie des gaz, des modèles de déformation et de la façon dont la croûte répond aux contraintes répétées — et des travaux récents ont souligné un troisième facteur qui complique le tableau : après des décennies d'étirements et de secousses, la croûte superficielle ici peut simplement être plus faible qu'elle ne l'était, ce qui signifie qu'elle se fracture à des contraintes plus faibles qu'auparavant.

segments.src: Under that reading, more frequent earthquakes are partly a sign of a fatigued lid, not necessarily a stronger push from beneath.
segments.tr: Selon cette lecture, des séismes plus fréquents sont en partie le signe d'un couvercle fatigué, et non nécessairement d'une poussée plus forte depuis le bas.

segments.src: That is a genuinely important nuance, and it cuts both ways.
segments.tr: C'est une nuance véritablement importante, et elle joue dans les deux sens.

segments.src: It offers a less alarming explanation for rising quake counts.
segments.tr: Elle offre une explication moins alarmante pour l'augmentation du nombre de séismes.

segments.src: It also means the system's behavior is changing in ways that make historical analogies less reliable.
segments.tr: Elle signifie également que le comportement du système change d'une manière qui rend les analogies historiques moins fiables.

segments.src: ## The 1982–84 precedent
segments.tr: ## Le précédent de 1982–84

segments.src: The last major bradyseismic crisis ran from 1982 to 1984 and lifted the ground at Pozzuoli by roughly 1.8 meters.
segments.tr: La dernière crise bradyseismique majeure s'est déroulée de 1982 à 1984 et a soulevé le sol à Pozzuoli d'environ 1,8 mètre.

segments.src: Tens of thousands of residents were relocated; the old town core of Rione Terra was evacuated and stayed largely empty for years afterward.
segments.tr: Des dizaines de milliers de résidents ont été relocalisés ; le centre historique de Rione Terra a été évacué et est resté largement vide pendant des années après cela.

segments.src: Then the ground stopped, settled somewhat, and the crisis ended without an eruption.
segments.tr: Ensuite, le sol s'est arrêté, s'est stabilisé quelque peu, et la crise s'est terminée sans éruption.

segments.src: That is the most useful precedent available, and it points in a reassuring direction — sustained, meters-scale uplift ended quietly.
segments.tr: C'est le précédent le plus utile disponible, et il pointe dans une direction rassurante — un soulèvement soutenu à l'échelle de plusieurs mètres s'est terminé tranquillement.

segments.src: But the current episode has now run far longer than that one, at a slower rate, and it is arriving in a place with two more generations of construction on top of it.
segments.tr: Mais l'épisode actuel dure maintenant beaucoup plus longtemps que celui-là, à un rythme plus lent, et il arrive dans un lieu avec deux générations de constructions supplémentaires par-dessus.

segments.src: ## What is being watched, and what would change the assessment
segments.tr: ## Ce qui est surveillé, et ce qui changerait l'évaluation

segments.src: If you want to follow this the way monitoring agencies do, the meaningful indicators are not the magnitude headlines.
segments.tr: Si vous voulez suivre cela comme le font les agences de surveillance, les indicateurs significatifs ne sont pas les titres sur la magnitude.

segments.src: They are:
segments.tr: Ils sont :

segments.src: - **Uplift rate**, measured in millimeters per month by GPS stations and satellite radar. Acceleration matters far more than the accumulated total.
segments.tr: - **Le taux de soulèvement**, mesuré en millimètres par mois par des stations GPS et des radars satellites. L'accélération importe bien plus que le total accumulé.

segments.src: - **Earthquake depth.** Persistent shallow activity fits the hydrothermal picture. A sustained migration of seismicity toward the surface, or new activity at intermediate depths, would be a different signal.
segments.tr: - **La profondeur des séismes.** Une activité superficielle persistante correspond au schéma hydrothermal. Une migration soutenue de la sismicité vers la surface, ou une nouvelle activité à des profondeurs intermédiaires, serait un signal différent.

segments.src: - **Gas chemistry** at the Solfatara and Pisciarelli fumarole fields — particularly the ratios of carbon dioxide to water vapor and helium isotopes, which help distinguish a magmatic contribution from a purely hydrothermal one.
segments.tr: - **La chimie des gaz** aux champs de fumerolles de Solfatara et Pisciarelli — particulièrement les ratios de dioxyde de carbone par rapport à la vapeur d'eau et les isotopes d'hélium, qui aident à distinguer une contribution magmatique d'une contribution purement hydrothermale.

segments.src: - **Ground temperature and emission flux**, which track how much heat the system is moving.
segments.tr: - **La température du sol et le flux d'émission**, qui suivent la quantité de chaleur que le système déplace.

segments.src: None of those has a single threshold that flips a switch.
segments.tr: Aucun de ces éléments n'a de seuil unique qui déclenche un interrupteur.

segments.src: Alert-level changes are made on a package of evidence by a national commission, not on any one reading.
segments.tr: Les changements de niveau d'alerte sont effectués sur la base d'un ensemble de preuves par une commission nationale, et non sur la base d'une seule lecture.

segments.src: ## The practical layer
segments.tr: ## La couche pratique

segments.src: For residents and visitors, the operative guidance is unglamorous and comes from Italy's Civil Protection Department and municipal authorities, not from any article:
segments.tr: Pour les résidents et les visiteurs, les conseils opérationnels sont sans éclat et proviennent du Département de la Protection Civile d'Italie et des autorités municipales, et non d'un article :

segments.src: - Know whether your address falls in the designated hazard zones, and know the assigned assembly points and evacuation route — the local comune publishes them.
segments.tr: - Sachez si votre adresse se trouve dans les zones de danger désignées, et connaissez les points de rassemblement assignés et l'itinéraire d'évacuation — la commune locale les publie.

segments.src: - Keep the standard earthquake habits: secure heavy furniture, know which interior wall or doorway you would move to, keep documents and medications somewhere you can grab them.
segments.tr: - Gardez les habitudes sismiques standard : fixez les meubles lourds, sachez vers quel mur intérieur ou porte vous vous déplaceriez, gardez vos documents et médicaments là où vous pouvez les saisir rapidement.

segments.src: - Treat official channels as the source of truth during an event. Aftershock sequences in this caldera routinely produce a wave of speculation that outruns the data by hours.
segments.tr: - Considérez les canaux officiels comme la source de vérité pendant un événement. Les séquences de répliques dans cette caldeira produisent couramment une vague de spéculations qui dépasse les données de plusieurs heures.

segments.src: - If a building has been posted as unusable after inspection, that assessment reflects strain that is not always visible from the street.
segments.tr: - Si un bâtiment a été déclaré inutilisable après inspection, cette évaluation reflète une tension qui n'est pas toujours visible depuis la rue.

segments.src: ## The wider point
segments.tr: ## Le point plus large

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is a stress test for something more general than volcanology.
segments.tr: Les Campi Flegrei sont un test de résistance pour quelque chose de plus général que la volcanologie.

segments.src: It is what happens when a slow-moving natural hazard sits under a place people cannot simply leave — where the housing is old, the economy is local, the deadline is unknown, and the honest scientific answer is "we are monitoring it, and it may go on like this for years."
segments.tr: C'est ce qui arrive quand un risque naturel à mouvement lent se trouve sous un endroit que les gens ne peuvent tout simplement pas quitter — où le logement est ancien, l'économie est locale, l'échéance est inconnue, et la réponse scientifique honnête est "nous le surveillons, et cela peut continuer ainsi pendant des années."

segments.src: The port reopens.
segments.tr: Le port rouvre.

segments.src: The households return or they don't.
segments.tr: Les foyers reviennent ou non.

segments.src: The instruments keep logging millimeters.
segments.tr: Les instruments continuent d'enregistrer des millimètres.

segments.src: Four and a half feet accumulated in twenty-one years is not a headline on any single day, which is precisely why it took a magnitude 4.7 to make anyone outside Naples look at it.
segments.tr: Quatre pieds et demi accumulés en vingt et un ans n'est pas un titre de presse un jour donné, c'est précisément pourquoi il a fallu un séisme de magnitude 4,7 pour que quiconque en dehors de Naples y prête attention.

segments.tr: *Cet article résume les informations rapportées publiquement et la compréhension scientifique actuelle publiée sur la caldeira des Campi Flegrei.

segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales, et non de conseils d'urgence — pour des instructions spécifiques à la situation, suivez le Département de la Protection Civile d'Italie et les autorités municipales locales.*

pt.title: O Solo sob Nápoles Subiu Quatro Metros e Meio: Por Dentro do Alerta de 40 Anos dos Campi Flegrei

segments.src: On the last day of July, the ground west of Naples moved hard enough to close a working port.
segments.tr: No último dia de julho, o solo a oeste de Nápoles moveu-se com força suficiente para fechar um porto em operação.

segments.src: The magnitude 4.7 earthquake that struck the Campi Flegrei caldera on July 31 was, by the reckoning of Italy's national geophysics institute, the strongest tremor the area has produced in roughly four decades.
segments.tr: O terremoto de magnitude 4,7 que atingiu a caldeira de Campi Flegrei em 31 de julho foi, segundo a avaliação do instituto nacional de geofísica da Itália, o tremor mais forte que a área produziu em aproximadamente quatro décadas.

segments.src: Twenty-six people were reported injured.
segments.tr: Vinte e seis pessoas foram relatadas como feridas.

segments.src: Around 130 households were emptied while engineers checked walls and stairwells.
segments.tr: Cerca de 130 famílias foram retiradas enquanto engenheiros verificavam paredes e vãos de escada.

segments.src: The port of Pozzuoli — the ferry link to Ischia and Procida, and a piece of ordinary economic infrastructure for tens of thousands of people — was closed for inspection.
segments.tr: O porto de Pozzuoli — a ligação de balsa para Ischia e Procida, e uma peça de infraestrutura econômica comum para dezenas de milhares de pessoas — foi fechado para inspeção.

segments.src: Those are the numbers that traveled.
segments.tr: Esses são os números que circularam.

segments.src: But they are not the story.
segments.tr: Mas eles não são a história.

segments.src: The story is slower, quieter, and considerably stranger: the floor of the caldera has been rising, more or less continuously, for two decades.
segments.tr: A história é mais lenta, mais silenciosa e consideravelmente mais estranha: o chão da caldeira tem subido, mais ou menos continuamente, há duas décadas.

segments.src: Since 2005, the ground at the center of the uplift has swelled by more than 140 centimeters — about four and a half feet.
segments.tr: Desde 2005, o solo no centro da elevação inchou mais de 140 centímetros — cerca de quatro pés e meio.

segments.tr: Isso não é uma metáfora.

segments.tr: Quando o choque agudo finalmente chega, ele atinge uma estrutura que já gastou parte de sua resistência.

segments.tr: É por isso que os relatórios de danos locais tendem a descrever cornijas, vãos de escada e alvenarias mais antigas, em vez de colapsos dramáticos, e é por isso que o programa de vistoria de edifícios da Itália na área se concentrou na vulnerabilidade cumulativa, e não em qualquer evento único.

segments.src: ## Rising ground is not a countdown
segments.tr: ## Solo em elevação não é uma contagem regressiva

segments.src: Here is the part that deserves care, because it is where public understanding usually goes wrong.
segments.tr: Aqui está a parte que merece cuidado, porque é onde a compreensão pública geralmente falha.

segments.src: Uplift is not a schedule.
segments.tr: A elevação não é um cronograma.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei has been at the "yellow" attention level in Italy's four-tier volcanic alert system since 2012 — a designation that means monitoring has been intensified and parameters are being tracked closely, not that an eruption has been forecast.
segments.tr: Campi Flegrei tem estado no nível de atenção "amarelo" no sistema de alerta vulcânico de quatro níveis da Itália desde 2012 — uma designação que significa que o monitoramento foi intensificado e os parâmetros estão sendo acompanhados de perto, não que uma erupção foi prevista.

segments.src: The system has three levels above yellow, and moving between them requires specific, agreed-upon changes in the data.
segments.tr: O sistema tem três níveis acima do amarelo, e a mudança entre eles requer alterações específicas e acordadas nos dados.

segments.src: Researchers broadly work with two overlapping explanations for the current unrest, and the honest answer is that they are difficult to separate from the surface:
segments.tr: Pesquisadores trabalham amplamente com duas explicações sobrepostas para a agitação atual, e a resposta honesta é que elas são difíceis de separar da superfície:

segments.src: - **A hydrothermal interpretation.** Superheated water and gas — much of it originating from magma sitting several kilometers down — migrate into shallow rock, pressurize it, and lift it. This can produce years of uplift, gas emission, and shallow seismicity without magma itself rising to shallow depth.
segments.tr: - **Uma interpretação hidrotermal.** Água e gás superaquecidos — grande parte originada de magma situado a vários quilômetros de profundidade — migram para a rocha rasa, pressurizam-na e a elevam. Isso pode produzir anos de elevação, emissão de gás e sismicidade rasa sem que o próprio magma suba a profundidades rasas.

segments.src: - **A magmatic interpretation.** A body of magma at depth is intruding or degassing more actively, driving the same signals from below.
segments.tr: - **Uma interpretação magmática.** Um corpo de magma em profundidade está intrudindo ou desgaseificando mais ativamente, impulsionando os mesmos sinais de baixo.

segments.src: Both produce uplift.
segments.tr: Ambos produzem elevação.

segments.src: Both produce earthquakes.
segments.tr: Ambos produzem terremotos.

segments.src: The discriminating evidence tends to come from gas chemistry, deformation patterns, and how the crust responds to repeated stress — and recent work has emphasized a third factor that complicates the picture: after decades of being stretched and shaken, the shallow crust here may simply be weaker than it was, meaning it fractures at lower stress than it used to.
segments.tr: As evidências discriminatórias tendem a vir da química dos gases, padrões de deformação e como a crosta responde ao estresse repetido — e trabalhos recentes enfatizaram um terceiro fator que complica a imagem: após décadas de ser esticada e sacudida, a crosta rasa aqui pode simplesmente estar mais fraca do que era, significando que ela fratura sob estresse menor do que costumava.

segments.src: Under that reading, more frequent earthquakes are partly a sign of a fatigued lid, not necessarily a stronger push from beneath.
segments.tr: Sob essa leitura, terremotos mais frequentes são, em parte, um sinal de uma tampa fatigada, não necessariamente um empurrão mais forte de baixo.

segments.src: That is a genuinely important nuance, and it cuts both ways.
segments.tr: Essa é uma nuance genuinamente importante, e ela corta nos dois sentidos.

segments.src: It offers a less alarming explanation for rising quake counts.
segments.tr: Ela oferece uma explicação menos alarmante para o aumento na contagem de tremores.

segments.src: It also means the system's behavior is changing in ways that make historical analogies less reliable.
segments.tr: Também significa que o comportamento do sistema está mudando de maneiras que tornam as analogias históricas menos confiáveis.

segments.src: ## The 1982–84 precedent
segments.tr: ## O precedente de 1982–84

segments.src: The last major bradyseismic crisis ran from 1982 to 1984 and lifted the ground at Pozzuoli by roughly 1.8 meters.
segments.tr: A última grande crise bradiseímica ocorreu de 1982 a 1984 e elevou o solo em Pozzuoli em aproximadamente 1,8 metros.

segments.src: Tens of thousands of residents were relocated; the old town core of Rione Terra was evacuated and stayed largely empty for years afterward.
segments.tr: Dezenas de milhares de residentes foram realocados; o núcleo da cidade antiga de Rione Terra foi evacuado e permaneceu amplamente vazio por anos depois.

segments.src: Then the ground stopped, settled somewhat, and the crisis ended without an eruption.
segments.tr: Então o solo parou, assentou um pouco e a crise terminou sem uma erupção.

segments.src: That is the most useful precedent available, and it points in a reassuring direction — sustained, meters-scale uplift ended quietly.
segments.tr: Esse é o precedente mais útil disponível, e ele aponta em uma direção tranquilizadora — a elevação sustentada em escala de metros terminou silenciosamente.

segments.src: But the current episode has now run far longer than that one, at a slower rate, and it is arriving in a place with two more generations of construction on top of it.
segments.tr: Mas o episódio atual já durou muito mais do que aquele, em um ritmo mais lento, e está ocorrendo em um lugar com mais duas gerações de construções sobre ele.

segments.src: ## What is being watched, and what would change the assessment
segments.tr: ## O que está sendo observado e o que mudaria a avaliação

segments.src: If you want to follow this the way monitoring agencies do, the meaningful indicators are not the magnitude headlines.
segments.tr: Se você quiser acompanhar isso da mesma forma que as agências de monitoramento fazem, os indicadores significativos não são as manchetes de magnitude.

segments.src: They are:
segments.tr: Eles são:

segments.src: - **Uplift rate**, measured in millimeters per month by GPS stations and satellite radar. Acceleration matters far more than the accumulated total.
segments.tr: - **Taxa de elevação**, medida em milímetros por mês por estações de GPS e radar de satélite. A aceleração importa muito mais do que o total acumulado.

segments.src: - **Earthquake depth.** Persistent shallow activity fits the hydrothermal picture. A sustained migration of seismicity toward the surface, or new activity at intermediate depths, would be a different signal.
segments.tr: - **Profundidade do terremoto.** A atividade rasa persistente se encaixa na imagem hidrotermal. Uma migração sustentada da sismicidade em direção à superfície, ou nova atividade em profundidades intermediárias, seria um sinal diferente.

segments.src: - **Gas chemistry** at the Solfatara and Pisciarelli fumarole fields — particularly the ratios of carbon dioxide to water vapor and helium isotopes, which help distinguish a magmatic contribution from a purely hydrothermal one.
segments.tr: - **Química dos gases** nos campos de fumarolas de Solfatara e Pisciarelli — particularmente as proporções de dióxido de carbono para vapor de água e isótopos de hélio, que ajudam a distinguir uma contribuição magmática de uma puramente hidrotermal.

segments.src: - **Ground temperature and emission flux**, which track how much heat the system is moving.
segments.tr: - **Temperatura do solo e fluxo de emissão**, que rastreiam quanto calor o sistema está movendo.

segments.src: None of those has a single threshold that flips a switch.
segments.tr: Nenhum desses tem um limite único que aciona um interruptor.

segments.src: Alert-level changes are made on a package of evidence by a national commission, not on any one reading.
segments.tr: Mudanças no nível de alerta são feitas com base em um conjunto de evidências por uma comissão nacional, não em qualquer leitura individual.

segments.src: ## The practical layer
segments.tr: ## A camada prática

segments.src: For residents and visitors, the operative guidance is unglamorous and comes from Italy's Civil Protection Department and municipal authorities, not from any article:
segments.tr: Para residentes e visitantes, a orientação operacional é desinteressante e vem do Departamento de Proteção Civil da Itália e das autoridades municipais, não de qualquer artigo:

segments.src: - Know whether your address falls in the designated hazard zones, and know the assigned assembly points and evacuation route — the local comune publishes them.
segments.tr: - Saiba se o seu endereço está nas zonas de risco designadas e conheça os pontos de encontro atribuídos e a rota de evacuação — o comune local os publica.

segments.src: - Keep the standard earthquake habits: secure heavy furniture, know which interior wall or doorway you would move to, keep documents and medications somewhere you can grab them.
segments.tr: - Mantenha os hábitos padrão de terremotos: prenda móveis pesados, saiba para qual parede interna ou portal você se moveria, mantenha documentos e medicamentos em algum lugar onde possa pegá-los rapidamente.

segments.src: - Treat official channels as the source of truth during an event. Aftershock sequences in this caldera routinely produce a wave of speculation that outruns the data by hours.
segments.tr: - Trate os canais oficiais como a fonte da verdade durante um evento. Sequências de tremores secundários nesta caldeira rotineiramente produzem uma onda de especulação que ultrapassa os dados por horas.

segments.src: - If a building has been posted as unusable after inspection, that assessment reflects strain that is not always visible from the street.
segments.tr: - Se um edifício foi marcado como inutilizável após a inspeção, essa avaliação reflete uma tensão que nem sempre é visível da rua.

segments.src: ## The wider point
segments.tr: ## O ponto mais amplo

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is a stress test for something more general than volcanology.
segments.tr: Campi Flegrei é um teste de estresse para algo mais geral do que a vulcanologia.

segments.src: It is what happens when a slow-moving natural hazard sits under a place people cannot simply leave — where the housing is old, the economy is local, the deadline is unknown, and the honest scientific answer is "we are monitoring it, and it may go on like this for years."
segments.tr: É o que acontece quando um risco natural de movimento lento fica sob um lugar que as pessoas não podem simplesmente deixar — onde a habitação é antiga, a economia é local, o prazo é desconhecido e a resposta científica honesta é "estamos monitorando, e isso pode continuar assim por anos".

segments.src: The port reopens.
segments.tr: O porto reabre.

segments.src: The households return or they don't.
segments.tr: As famílias retornam ou não.

segments.src: The instruments keep logging millimeters.
segments.tr: Os instrumentos continuam registrando milímetros.

segments.src: Four and a half feet accumulated in twenty-one years is not a headline on any single day, which is precisely why it took a magnitude 4.7 to make anyone outside Naples look at it.
segments.tr: Quatro pés e meio acumulados em vinte e um anos não é uma manchete de um único dia, e é precisamente por isso que foi necessário um terremoto de magnitude 4,7 para fazer qualquer pessoa fora de Nápoles olhar para isso.

segments.src: *This article summarizes publicly reported information and the current published scientific understanding of the Campi Flegrei caldera.
segments.tr: *Este artigo resume informações relatadas publicamente e a compreensão científica atual publicada sobre a caldeira de Campi Flegrei.

segments.src: Figures on damage, injuries, and displacement reflect initial official reports and are commonly revised.
segments.tr: Números de danos, feridos e deslocamentos refletem relatórios oficiais iniciais e são comumente revisados.

segments.src: It is general information, not emergency guidance — for situation-specific instructions, follow Italy's Civil Protection Department and local municipal authorities.*
segments.tr: São informações gerais, não orientações de emergência — para instruções específicas da situação, siga o Departamento de Proteção Civil da Itália e as autoridades municipais locais.*

in.title: Tanah di Bawah Naples Telah Naik Empat Setengah Kaki: Di Dalam Peringatan 40 Tahun Campi Flegrei

segments.src: On the last day of July, the ground west of Naples moved hard enough to close a working port.
segments.tr: Pada hari terakhir bulan Juli, tanah di sebelah barat Naples bergerak cukup kuat hingga menutup pelabuhan yang sedang beroperasi.

segments.src: The magnitude 4.7 earthquake that struck the Campi Flegrei caldera on July 31 was, by the reckoning of Italy's national geophysics institute, the strongest tremor the area has produced in roughly four decades.
segments.tr: Gempa bumi bermagnitudo 4,7 yang melanda kaldera Campi Flegrei pada 31 Juli adalah, menurut perhitungan institut geofisika nasional Italia, getaran terkuat yang dihasilkan area tersebut dalam kira-kira empat dekade.

segments.src: Twenty-six people were reported injured.
segments.tr: Dua puluh enam orang dilaporkan terluka.

segments.src: Around 130 households were emptied while engineers checked walls and stairwells.
segments.tr: Sekitar 130 rumah tangga dikosongkan sementara insinyur memeriksa dinding dan tangga.

segments.src: The port of Pozzuoli — the ferry link to Ischia and Procida, and a piece of ordinary economic infrastructure for tens of thousands of people — was closed for inspection.
segments.tr: Pelabuhan Pozzuoli — penghubung feri ke Ischia dan Procida, serta bagian dari infrastruktur ekonomi biasa bagi puluhan ribu orang — ditutup untuk pemeriksaan.

segments.src: Those are the numbers that traveled.
segments.tr: Itulah angka-angka yang tersebar.

segments.src: But they are not the story.
segments.tr: Namun itu bukan ceritanya.

segments.src: The story is slower, quieter, and considerably stranger: the floor of the caldera has been rising, more or less continuously, for two decades.
segments.tr: Ceritanya lebih lambat, lebih tenang, dan jauh lebih aneh: dasar kaldera telah naik, kurang lebih secara terus-menerus, selama dua dekade.

segments.src: Since 2005, the ground at the center of the uplift has swelled by more than 140 centimeters — about four and a half feet.
segments.tr: Sejak 2005, tanah di pusat pengangkatan telah membengkak lebih dari 140 sentimeter — sekitar empat setengah kaki.

segments.src: That is not a metaphor.
segments.tr: Itu bukan metafora.

segments.src: The coastline near Pozzuoli is physically higher than it was when the first iPhone shipped.
segments.tr: Garis pantai di dekat Pozzuoli secara fisik lebih tinggi daripada saat iPhone pertama dikirimkan.

segments.src: ## What bradyseism actually is
segments.tr: ## Apa itu bradyseism sebenarnya

segments.src: The phenomenon has a name that predates modern volcanology: *bradyseism*, from the Greek for "slow movement."
segments.tr: Fenomena ini memiliki nama yang sudah ada sebelum vulkanologi modern: *bradyseism*, dari bahasa Yunani yang berarti "gerakan lambat."

segments.src: It describes the gradual rise and fall of the ground surface inside a volcanic caldera, driven not by lava but by pressure — hot fluids, gases, and possibly magma at depth pushing the rock above them upward like a slow hydraulic jack, then letting it settle again.
segments.tr: Ini menggambarkan kenaikan dan penurunan bertahap permukaan tanah di dalam kaldera vulkanik, yang didorong bukan oleh lava, tetapi oleh tekanan — cairan panas, gas, dan kemungkinan magma di kedalaman yang mendorong batuan di atasnya ke atas seperti dongkrak hidrolik lambat, lalu membiarkannya turun kembali.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is the textbook case.
segments.tr: Campi Flegrei adalah kasus buku teks.

segments.src: The Romans built a market at Pozzuoli, the Macellum, whose surviving columns carry a band of holes bored by marine mollusks several meters above the modern floor.
segments.tr: Bangsa Romawi membangun pasar di Pozzuoli, Macellum, yang kolom-kolomnya yang masih bertahan membawa pita lubang yang dibor oleh moluska laut beberapa meter di atas lantai modern.

segments.src: Those holes are a tide gauge running two thousand years long.
segments.tr: Lubang-lubang itu adalah pengukur pasang surut yang berjalan selama dua ribu tahun.

segments.src: The ground sank below sea level, sat there for centuries, and rose again.
segments.tr: Tanah tenggelam di bawah permukaan laut, berada di sana selama berabad-abad, dan naik kembali.

segments.src: Naples has been living on a piston this whole time.
segments.tr: Naples telah hidup di atas piston selama ini.

segments.src: The caldera itself is about 12 to 15 kilometers across, and most of it is not a mountain.
segments.tr: Kaldera itu sendiri memiliki lebar sekitar 12 hingga 15 kilometer, dan sebagian besar bukan merupakan gunung.

segments.src: It is a shallow bowl of neighborhoods, ports, thermal baths, and highways, partly submerged under the Gulf of Pozzuoli, partly overlapping the western districts of Naples proper.
segments.tr: Ini adalah mangkuk dangkal berisi lingkungan, pelabuhan, pemandian air panas, dan jalan raya, sebagian terendam di bawah Teluk Pozzuoli, sebagian tumpang tindih dengan distrik barat Naples sendiri.

segments.src: Roughly half a million people live inside it.
segments.tr: Kira-kira setengah juta orang tinggal di dalamnya.

segments.src: That density — European, coastal, historic, and built long before anyone modeled seismic loads — is the variable that turns a geophysics problem into a civil-protection problem.
segments.tr: Kepadatan itu — Eropa, pesisir, bersejarah, dan dibangun jauh sebelum siapa pun memodelkan beban seismik — adalah variabel yang mengubah masalah geofisika menjadi masalah perlindungan sipil.

segments.src: ## Why a 4.7 hurts more here
segments.tr: ## Mengapa 4,7 lebih menyakitkan di sini

segments.src: A magnitude 4.7 is not a large earthquake by global standards.
segments.tr: Magnitudo 4,7 bukanlah gempa bumi besar menurut standar global.

segments.src: In many parts of the world it would rattle dishes and make the local news for one cycle.
segments.tr: Di banyak bagian dunia, itu hanya akan menggetarkan piring dan menjadi berita lokal untuk satu siklus.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei is different for two reasons.
segments.tr: Campi Flegrei berbeda karena dua alasan.

segments.src: **The quakes are extremely shallow.** Most caldera seismicity here originates within a few kilometers of the surface, some of it much shallower than that.
segments.tr: **Gempa bumi sangat dangkal.** Sebagian besar seismisitas kaldera di sini berasal dari beberapa kilometer dari permukaan, beberapa di antaranya jauh lebih dangkal dari itu.

segments.src: Energy that would dissipate through the crust on its way up from a 30-kilometer hypocenter instead arrives almost immediately, concentrated under a small area.
segments.tr: Energi yang akan menghilang melalui kerak bumi dalam perjalanannya naik dari hiposenter 30 kilometer, sebaliknya tiba hampir seketika, terkonsentrasi di bawah area kecil.

segments.src: The shaking is sharp, loud, and disproportionate to the magnitude number.
segments.tr: Guncangannya tajam, keras, dan tidak proporsional dengan angka magnitudonya.

segments.src: **The buildings have been strained for years, not seconds.** This is the point most easily lost.
segments.tr: **Bangunan-bangunan telah tertekan selama bertahun-tahun, bukan detik.** Ini adalah poin yang paling mudah terlewatkan.

segments.src: Uplift does not merely precede earthquakes; it deforms structures directly.
segments.tr: Pengangkatan tidak sekadar mendahului gempa bumi; itu mengubah bentuk struktur secara langsung.

segments.src: A masonry building whose foundation has tilted and stretched a few centimeters over a decade is not the same building it was — it has accumulated cracks, lost stiffness, and shed some of its margin.
segments.tr: Bangunan bata yang fondasinya telah miring dan meregang beberapa sentimeter selama satu dekade bukanlah bangunan yang sama seperti sebelumnya — ia telah mengumpulkan retakan, kehilangan kekakuan, dan kehilangan sebagian margin keamanannya.

segments.src: When the sharp shock finally arrives, it lands on a structure already partway through its budget.
segments.tr: Ketika guncangan tajam akhirnya tiba, ia menghantam struktur yang sudah sebagian terpakai anggarannya.

segments.src: That is why local damage reports tend to describe cornices, stairwells, and older masonry rather than dramatic collapses, and it is why Italy's building-survey program in the area has focused on cumulative vulnerability rather than any single event.
segments.tr: Itulah mengapa laporan kerusakan lokal cenderung menggambarkan cornice, tangga, dan bata tua daripada runtuhan dramatis, dan itulah mengapa program survei bangunan Italia di area tersebut berfokus pada kerentanan kumulatif daripada peristiwa tunggal.

segments.src: ## Rising ground is not a countdown
segments.tr: ## Tanah yang naik bukan merupakan hitung mundur

segments.src: Here is the part that deserves care, because it is where public understanding usually goes wrong.
segments.tr: Inilah bagian yang memerlukan perhatian, karena di sinilah pemahaman publik biasanya salah.

segments.src: Uplift is not a schedule.
segments.tr: Pengangkatan bukanlah jadwal.

segments.src: Campi Flegrei has been at the "yellow" attention level in Italy's four-tier volcanic alert system since 2012 — a designation that means monitoring has been intensified and parameters are being tracked closely, not that an eruption has been forecast.
segments.tr: Campi Flegrei telah berada pada tingkat perhatian "kuning" dalam sistem peringatan vulkanik empat tingkat Italia sejak 2012 — sebuah penunjukan yang berarti pemantauan telah ditingkatkan dan parameter sedang dilacak dengan ketat, bukan berarti letusan telah diramalkan.

segments.src: The system has three levels above yellow, and moving between them requires specific, agreed-upon changes in the data.
segments.tr: Sistem ini memiliki tiga tingkat di atas kuning, dan perpindahan di antara tingkat tersebut memerlukan perubahan spesifik yang disepakati dalam data.

segments.src: Researchers broadly work with two overlapping explanations for the current unrest, and the honest answer is that they are difficult to separate from the surface:
segments.tr: Para peneliti secara luas bekerja dengan dua penjelasan yang tumpang tindih untuk kegelisahan saat ini, dan jawaban jujurnya adalah bahwa mereka sulit dipisahkan dari permukaan:

segments.src: - **A hydrothermal interpretation.** Superheated water and gas — much of it originating from magma sitting several kilometers down — migrate into shallow rock, pressurize it, and lift it. This can produce years of uplift, gas emission, and shallow seismicity without magma itself rising to shallow depth.
segments.tr: - **Interpretasi hidrotermal.** Air dan gas superpanas — sebagian besar berasal dari magma yang berada beberapa kilometer di bawah — bermigrasi ke batuan dangkal, memberi tekanan padanya, dan mengangkatnya. Ini dapat menghasilkan pengangkatan selama bertahun-tahun, emisi gas, dan seismisitas dangkal tanpa magma itu sendiri naik ke kedalaman dangkal.

segments.src: - **A magmatic interpretation.** A body of magma at depth is intruding or degassing more actively, driving the same signals from below.
segments.tr: - **Interpretasi magmatik.** Sebuah badan magma di kedalaman sedang mengintrusi atau mengeluarkan gas lebih aktif, mendorong sinyal yang sama dari bawah.

segments.src: Both produce uplift.
segments.tr: Keduanya menghasilkan pengangkatan.

segments.src: Both produce earthquakes.
segments.tr: Keduanya menghasilkan gempa bumi.

segments.src: The discriminating evidence tends to come from gas chemistry, deformation patterns, and how the crust responds to repeated stress — and recent work has emphasized a third factor that complicates the picture: after decades of being stretched and shaken, the shallow crust here may simply be weaker than it was, meaning it fractures at lower stress than it used to.
segments.tr: Bukti pembeda cenderung datang dari kimia gas, pola deformasi, dan bagaimana kerak bumi merespons stres berulang — dan pekerjaan terbaru telah menekankan faktor ketiga yang memperumit gambaran tersebut: setelah dekade diregangkan dan diguncang, kerak dangkal di sini mungkin hanya lebih lemah daripada sebelumnya, yang berarti ia retak pada stres yang lebih rendah daripada biasanya.

segments.src: Under that reading, more frequent earthquakes are partly a sign of a fatigued lid, not necessarily a stronger push from beneath.
segments.tr: Dalam pembacaan itu, gempa bumi yang lebih sering terjadi sebagian adalah tanda dari tutup yang lelah, bukan harus dorongan yang lebih kuat dari bawah.

segments.src: That is a genuinely important nuance, and it cuts both ways.
segments.tr: Itu adalah nuansa yang benar-benar penting, dan itu berlaku dua arah.

segments.src: It offers a less alarming explanation for rising quake counts.
segments.tr: Ini menawarkan penjelasan yang kurang mengkhawatirkan untuk peningkatan jumlah gempa.

segments.src: It also means the system's behavior is changing in ways that make historical analogies less reliable.
segments.tr: Ini juga berarti perilaku sistem berubah dengan cara yang membuat analogi historis menjadi kurang dapat diandalkan.

segments.tr: ## Preseden 1982–84

segments.tr: Krisis bradyseismic besar terakhir berlangsung dari 1982 hingga 1984 dan mengangkat tanah di Pozzuoli sekitar 1,8 meter.
